name: Elvis
desc: White-jumpsuit rock'n'roll king with pompadour, shades and a mic — hip swivels, windmill arm, knee drops and rubber legs, seeded rhinestones twinkling to the treble and notes floating off the microphone.

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy (solo=obey pose; medley=cycle poses by section; finale=escalate idle to kneedrop)
